title: chaetoseris likiangensis
intro: Chaetoseris likiangensis, commonly known as the 'Liangshan cauldron flower', is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Chaetoseris likiangensis include its ability to relax the smooth muscles, exhibit sedative effects, and show potential in treating various diseases such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Chaetoseris likiangensis include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
